title: Clock underflow halts
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machines, let $c$ be a configuration of $W$ on Boolean input $x$ with state $q$ and output register $r$, and choose contents $kt$ and head positions $kh$ for the tapes corresponding to $K$. Let $\tau$ be a clock-tape content function and $z$ an integer. If the clock tape is blank at position $z$, then one step of the clock machine from the configuration with state $\mathrm{dec}(q,r)$, underlying configuration $c$, clock tape $\tau$, clock-head position $z$, tapes $kt,kh$, and empty output halts and has output consisting of the single bit $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $K$ and $W$ are finite Turing machines over Boolean symbols
$c$ is a configuration of $W$ on Boolean input $x$
$q$ is a state of $W$ and $r$ is an output-register value
$kt$ gives the contents of the $K$ work tapes
$kh$ gives the head positions of the $K$ work tapes
$\tau$ maps integer positions to optional Boolean symbols
